name: war
steps: log carrier sails: order a course and check the heli rides the deck
eval (()=>{ const c=__G.war.carrier; window.__c0=c.p.clone(); return __G.war.orderCarrier(c.p.x+200, c.p.z-200) && c.path.length })()
log capture: put the heli on the neutral FORGE pad and hold it

eval (()=>{ const I=__G.ISLANDS.find(i=>i.name==='FORGE'); __G.H.reset(new __G.THREE.Vector3(I.pad.x, I.pad.h+1.15, I.pad.z), 0, true, 1); __G.HI.setCollective(0); return [I.owner, __G.war.aliveAA(I)] })()
eval (()=>{ const I=__G.ISLANDS.find(i=>i.name==='FORGE'); return {owner:I.owner, cap:I.cap, alive:__G.Z.alive, landed:__G.H.landed} })()
log drone: send a capture drone to SANDBAR
log weapons: bomb an enemy AA gun on ANVIL from above

eval (()=>{ const I=__G.ISLANDS.find(i=>i.name==='ANVIL'); const g=I.structs.find(s=>s.kind==='aa'&&!s.dead); window.__g=g; __G.H.reset(new __G.THREE.Vector3(g.x, g.y+30, g.z), 0, false, 1); __G.HI.setCollective(0.47); __G.war.dropBomb(new __G.THREE.Vector3(g.x, g.y+12, g.z), new __G.THREE.Vector3(0,0,0)); return g.hp })()
